Difference in offsets: (-10) - (5.5) = -15.5 hours.  

10:00 (Kolkata) - 15 hours 30 minutes =  
10:00 - 15:30 = -5:30 → previous day.  
-5:30 + 24:00 = 18:30 previous day.  

Date: March 20, 1287 in Kolkata → March 19, 1287 in Hawaii at 18:30.
